item.title: Dead or Alive fans are eating well tonight: Koei Tecmo announces a new game is in development, and Dead Or Alive 6 Last Round launches this summer
item.description: It's been about seven years since we last had a meaningful udpate in the Dead or Alive franchise, but that all changed this evening when Koei Tecmo made an unexpected appearance at the PlayStation State of Play to give us some new about the beloved fighting series. Read more

item.title: The biggest surprise of the night? A brand new AAA John Wick game coming from the developer of Space Marine 2
item.description: Now, there were many things I was expecting to turn up at this evening's PlayStation State of Play. A Resident Evil Requiem demo, for example (I am not annoyed we don't have one yet, you are). One thing that wasn't on my bingo card, though, was a John Wick game. But, that's exactly what we got. Read more

item.title: The time has come for you to judge Marathon for yourself (again): there's a new 'server slam' running late Feb into March
item.description: Marathon is almost here, at long last. It's been a bumpy journey to get here, but the finish goal is finally in sight for Bungie. To celebrate the incoming launch, the developer has announced it will be hosting a Server Slam coming 26th February 26 and running until 2nd March. Which, for my money, is perilously close to the official release on 5th March. Read more

item.title: Crystal Dynamics just announced the first new Legacy of Kain game in 23 years (and another slick-looking Soul Reaver remaster, too)
item.description: The Legacy of Kain franchise might be one of the most beloved cult franchises in gaming (for Millennial goths with an English degree, like myself, at least). The dark fantasy action-adventure series kicked off with Blood Omen back in 1996, and followed that up with Soul Reaver in 1999, before a three-year run of Soul Reaver 2, Blood Omen 2, and Legacy of Kain: Defiance rounded off the series for a very long time in 2003. item.title: As Silent Hill's stellar revival continues, here's our first proper look at next game Silent Hill: Townfall
item.description: After years in the video game wilderness, Silent Hill finally feels like its back on track (we'll ignore the recent movie, however), and hopes are high that its winning streak will continue as we get our first proper look at the next game in the series, Silent Hill: Townfall. item.title: Open world PS5 game Project Windless is part-God of War, part-Dynasty Warriors, and has a veteran Far Cry director as its lead
item.description: What a terrible day to be a God of War-like! You put on your fanciest bird suit for your big reveal, then a whole bunch of actual God of Wars come along and steal your thunder. But that's not to say Krafton's new open-world PlayStation 5 game Project Windless isn't intriguing. Read more
